modules.name: shared-types
modules.description: Shared TypeScript type definitions for client and server

modules.name: core-engine
modules.description: 6-max NLHE game engine with deck, dealing, pot management, action validation, and showdown

modules.name: bot-ai
modules.description: Five BOT AI personality styles (TAG/LAG/Fish/Nit/Maniac) with differentiated decision-making

modules.name: session-manager
modules.description: Session lifecycle management — create, track, end, resume sessions

modules.name: preflop-solver
modules.description: Static preflop GTO strategy lookup from pre-computed 169×6×action-sequence tables

modules.name: postflop-solver
modules.description: Postflop GTO solving — precomputed cache + real-time DCFR WASM solver with precision metadata

modules.name: review-engine
modules.description: Hand review analysis — GTO comparison, deviation classification, EV loss estimation

modules.name: stats-engine
modules.description: Session statistics computation — profit curve, win rate, GTO conformance score

modules.name: api-layer
modules.description: Express REST API implementing OpenAPI spec routes

modules.name: table-ui
modules.description: React poker table UI — table layout, seats, cards, action bar, game loop interaction

modules.name: history-ui
modules.description: Hand history browsing UI with filtering and IndexedDB integration

modules.name: review-ui
modules.description: Hand replay and GTO comparison UI with deviation badges and precision disclaimers

modules.name: summary-ui
modules.description: Session summary dashboard with charts, stats, and GTO score

modules.name: client-storage
modules.description: IndexedDB abstraction for hand records and session checkpoint persistence
